title_en: Come On, When I Set Out
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'во комшии' is read as 'among the neighbors' and 'Ѓорѓија' as a man's name, my reading.

lines.en: Come on, when I set out, dear mother,
to water the horse at the spring.

lines.cyr: Море там' си најдов едно моме,
lines.lat: More tam' si najdov edno mome,
lines.en: Hey, there I found a girl,
a girl, lovely and beautiful.

lines.cyr: На, на, на, на, ла, ла, ла, ла.
lines.lat: Na, na, na, na, la, la, la, la.
lines.en: Na, na, na, na, la, la, la, la.
Come on, her eyes are like cherries,
her face a bright sun.
Hey, teach me, mother, advise me,

lines.cyr: што да правам да го земам?
lines.lat: što da pravam da go zemam?
lines.en: what should I do to take her?

lines.cyr: На, на, на, на, ла, ла, ла, ла.
lines.lat: Na, na, na, na, la, la, la, la.
lines.en: Na, na, na, na, la, la, la, la.
Come on, don't go mad, dear son,
don't go mad over the girl.
Hey, the girl is already promised
among the neighbors, to Gjorgija.

lines.cyr: На, на, на, на, ла, ла, ла, ла.
lines.lat: Na, na, na, na, la, la, la, la.
lines.en: Na, na, na, na, la, la, la, la.

lines.cyr: Ајде ќе го грабам, мила мамо
lines.lat: Ajde ḱe go grabam, mila mamo
lines.en: Come on, I will snatch her, dear mother,
I will snatch her from Gjorgija.

lines.cyr: Мори ќе го носам во одаја
lines.lat: Mori ḱe go nosam vo odaja
lines.en: Hey, I will take her to the room,
to the room, onto the divan.

lines.cyr: На, на, на, на, ла, ла, ла, ла.
lines.lat: Na, na, na, na, la, la, la, la.
lines.en: Na, na, na, na, la, la, la, la.
